reference_sql:
SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_id, l.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.ship_to_country = 'LU'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 00:00:00'
